name: Search Party
desc:
A horror game where the killer can only be seen when the lights go out.

SURVIVORS: Rescue crewmates and predict the killer's location.
KILLER: Position yourself when the lights are on, claim victims when they're off.

❤️ Join the Mega Drive group (my primary) to redeem codes!
⚠️ This game is in ALPHA. Content is subject to change.
